subject: Acme procurement readiness / PO vs Marketplace / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro / demo follow-up - procurement items and next steps

Hi Laura — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today’s discovery:

- Procurement path: you mentioned procurement prefers PO (vs card) and that standard vendor onboarding forms are required. Can you confirm the procurement contact and whether Acme requires a commercial invoice + W-9?
- Marketplace: you said there’s interest in AWS Marketplace for future purchases but procurement may want to close via PO to start. Do you want us to prioritize a marketplace listing or focus on a quick PO path?
- Timing: rough target for procurement sign-off was ‘end of June / early July’. Is that still accurate?
- Next steps I propose:
  1) I’ll share a pricing estimate, SOC2 summary, and a draft SOW for procurement review (attached).
  2) Please share procurement contact + required vendor docs and preferred billing terms (net30/net45, PO format).
  3) If helpful, I can set a 30-min intro between our finance/ops and your procurement lead next week.

Attachments: Redwood-Pricing-Estimate-ACME.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, Redwood-SOW-draft.docx

Thanks — I’ll follow up early next week with the docs and a short mutual action plan.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro / demo follow-up - procurement items and next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and the demo. A few answers from procurement: 

- We prefer to buy via PO for the initial deployment. Tom Rivera (tom.rivera@acme.com) is the procurement lead and will own the vendor forms.
- Required items: completed vendor onboarding form, commercial invoice, W-9, and SOC2 or equivalent security attestation.
- Marketplace: we are interested in AWS Marketplace long-term, but procurement said they are OK closing via PO first if it speeds things up.

Please send the pricing and SOC2 summary (we didn’t need the full report up front) and the filled vendor form. Tom, can you confirm any specific format requirements or a DocuSign link if needed?

Thanks —
Laura
Product Lead, Acme Corp
laura.chen@acme.com

Thanks Laura — attaching the items you requested.

Quick notes:
- Pricing: the attached estimate reflects the committed throughput and the discount we discussed in the call. If procurement needs a line-item commercial invoice, we can provide one based on the purchase order number.
- Vendor address / W-9: I’ve attached a stub of our vendor details; if procurement needs a completed W-9, I can route that from Finance (cc’d Rishi).
- Marketplace listing: we can pursue AWS Marketplace but that is typically a 2–4 week process from our side. If you want to close quickly, a PO should be faster.

Proposed next steps:
1) Tom — can we schedule a 30-min call next week to walk procurement through the vendor package and confirm PO requirements? (Slots: Tue 6/30 10am PT, Wed 7/1 11am PT)

3) We’ll send a short mutual action plan after the procurement touchpoint.

From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro / demo follow-up - procurement items and next steps

Marissa / Laura — Tom from Procurement here. A few quick items: 

- We will purchase via PO. Preferred terms: Net 30. We need a commercial invoice that references the PO number, a completed W-9, and Redwood’s vendor address.
- Vendor onboarding: please provide a completed vendor form (we received the stub — thanks). If you can provide a DocuSign link for the onboarding packet that would speed things up.
- Marketplace: we like Marketplace for future purchases but it won’t speed up the current procurement cycle — we prefer to close this initial engagement with a PO.

To move quickly: please send the commercial invoice + W-9 + DocuSign vendor packet. If you want, you can also provide a short invoice template we can attach to the PO.

Tom Rivera
Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com

Hi Tom / Laura — quick weekly check-in. Where is this currently stuck from your side? A few updates from us: 

- I attached a draft commercial invoice and a filled vendor onboarding packet (Acme-Procurement-Forms-filled-stub.pdf). Rishi from Finance is ready to produce an official W-9 and a final commercial invoice as soon as we have the PO number.
- We can accept a PO on net30 and will invoice against that PO; we’re also happy to provide a DocuSign onboarding packet if that’s fastest.
- If procurement would prefer to close quickly and revisit Marketplace later, we’re aligned to support that.

Next steps we suggest this week:
- Tom: confirm preferred billing address and PO number format so Rishi can generate the W-9/invoice correctly.
- Laura: confirm internal approvals and expected date for PO issuance.

If it helps, I’m happy to jump on a short sync to unblock any redlines — available Tue 6/30 10am PT or Wed 7/1 11am PT.

Thanks — nudging to keep this moving.

Hi Marissa — quick update from procurement: 

- Procurement confirmed PO path and Net 30 terms. They’re preparing the PO and expect to issue by next week.
- They asked that Redwood send a final commercial invoice and W-9 to procurement@acme.com; Tom will accept a DocuSign onboarding packet as well.
- Regarding Marketplace: procurement would prefer to close faster via PO for this initial engagement; we can revisit Marketplace for renewals.

Action items for Redwood:
1) Final commercial invoice (line-item pricing) + W-9 to procurement@acme.com
2) DocuSign vendor packet (optional but preferred by procurement)
3) Confirm Redwood vendor ID and billing address in the invoice

We’re aiming to close this first PO quickly — thanks for the follow-ups.

Best,
